properties.name: tunnel
properties.notes: digitised from a written description; not a survey
properties.quote: On the lower level northward for 380 feet from the crosscut tunnel the vein is locally 45 feet in width and in places contained good ore shoots, of which one of the best had a width of 8 feet and averaged $21 to the ton.

source.doc: USGS Bulletin 741, The Jarbidge Mining District, Nevada (F.C. Schrader, 1923), p. 31-32

properties.quote: For 380 feet southward from the crosscut tunnel the vein for the most part has good walls and shows ore in places.

source.doc: USGS Bulletin 741, The Jarbidge Mining District, Nevada (F.C. Schrader, 1923), p. 31-32
